slides.text: Minute 1: Write down every worry in one list. Your head stops looping once it is on paper.
Minute 2: Circle only the ones you can act on this week. Cross out the rest.
Minute 3: Pick the top 3 tasks for tomorrow and write them where you will see them first.
Minute 4: Do one tiny step now. Send one message. Open one file. Starting shrinks dread.
Then put the phone away and do something slow. A shower, a walk, music.
If this feeling is constant and heavy, please talk to a professional. This is general advice, not treatment.
Save this for your next Sunday.
slides.sub: Follow for one mind rule a day

caption:
A short reset for the Sunday scaries: list, filter, plan, one small step.
